decisions.reason: Adding rows to the Payment and Milestone Schedule table does not change whether the proposal includes a table of contents.
The schedule-table revision does not change the biography count, appendix placement, or biography integration method.
The source changes a proposal table, not the required narrative sections or the newly supplied Section 2 subsection.
The Payment and Milestone Schedule revision does not alter the one-page letter, signature insertion, or displaced-photo rules.
Adding rows to the schedule table does not change incorporation of the organization chart.
The source adds rows within a table and does not reorder or otherwise change the proposal sections.
Although additional rows may consume space, the source does not change the page-limit target, compliance goal, or compaction rule.
The existing full-document layout requirement already covers the proposal and its tables; the source does not change its layout strategy or coverage.
The schedule-table revision does not affect required photo selection, placement, or treatment.
The source revises one current proposal table and does not resume or change the deferred reusable-template requirement or its modular budget-table design.
Adding schedule-table rows does not change the proposal's Agua Arc identity, colors, or logo.
The source does not add, remove, or change any hyperlink requirement or hyperlink behavior.
